newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end down but rebound seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end down but rebound seen.

text.p: Austrian shares closed 0.59 percent down on Friday, the fourth staright day of losses, but traders said they expected to see a recovery next week.
"I think the whole market will get calmer and go back up again," said one trader.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips dropped to an intra-day low of 1,066.66 points before clawing back some ground to close at 1,068.94 -- 6.31 points down on the day.
Five ATX shares rose, 15 fell and one remained unchanged.
"We haven't yet tested the really low 1,060s, but it should go back up again on Monday," a market participant said.
National utility Verbund eased two schillings to 742 after the group said that it would have to work hard to match 1995's earnings this year.
The leading gainer of the session was luxury hosiery maker Wolford, jumping 21 schillings to 1,446.
Paper maker Leykam was the leading decliner, shedding 10 schillings to 300.
The November ATX future shed 4.8 points to 1,074.0.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index lost 2.32 points or 0.56 percent to end at 410.40. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
